authority: T0 exact finite-dimensional C1 equilibrium strict-cone no-go; not a TECT claim, tier change, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: For a finite-dimensional autonomous C1 flow at an equilibrium, a local finite-speed strict-support law on an open initial-data neighbourhood forces every positive-distance projected variational channel P_y exp(tA) P_x to vanish identically. Equivalently, every block P_y A^n P_x vanishes; Cayley-Hamilton reduces the decision to n below the total dimension. Any nonzero block power therefore gives an arbitrarily-small-time variational tail and rejects that nonlinear neighbourhood cone. LT3/ST8/Q3LOCK and the declared CP1a collocation regulator all trigger the obstruction. This does not reject Lieb-Robinson quasi-locality, controlled hyperbolic continuum limits, discrete-time causal parents, or QFT microcausality.
verdict: REJECT EXACT FINITE-SPEED STRICT SUPPORT FOR THE CURRENT FINITE AUTONOMOUS CONTINUOUS-TIME CANDIDATES; ADVANCE THE CONTROLLED CONTINUUM GOURSAT OR AN EXACT-CAUSAL ENLARGED PARENT; KEEP CP1 OPEN

theorem.phase_space: X=direct_sum_x X_x with finite total dimension D and declared positive block metric d
theorem.flow: an autonomous C1 local flow Phi_t with equilibrium z_* and linearization A=D F(z_*)
theorem.strict_support_hypothesis: for every sufficiently small perturbation u in source block X_x and 0<=t<d(x,y)/v, P_y[Phi_t(z_*+u)-Phi_t(z_*)]=0, where d(x,y)>0 and 0<v<infinity
theorem.derivative_consequence: P_y D Phi_t(z_*) P_x=P_y exp(tA) P_x=0 on a nonempty interval
theorem.entire_consequence: P_y A^n P_x=0 for every nonnegative integer n
theorem.leading_tail: if m is the least power with P_y A^m P_x nonzero, then the channel is t^m P_y A^m P_x/m!+O(t^(m+1)) and is nonzero for every sufficiently small positive time after choosing a witnessing source and target functional
theorem.dichotomy: a projected variational channel has either no waiting time or permanent decoupling; the theorem does not assert time analyticity of one isolated finite-amplitude nonlinear trajectory

hamiltonian_corollary.configuration_channel: P_qy A^2 P_qx=-(M^-1 K)_yx and q_y(t)=-(t^2/2)(M^-1 K)_yx q_x(0)+O(t^4)
hamiltonian_corollary.full_site_phase_channel: when a localization block contains both q_x and p_x, a nonzero stiffness edge already gives an order-t target momentum response
hamiltonian_corollary.scope: the configuration formula and full phase-space support statement are distinct and both are recorded

controls.disconnected_generator: all cross powers vanish and the variational channel remains identically zero
controls.discrete_time_shift: an exact nearest-neighbour shift has strict one-site-per-step support and lies outside the continuous-time hypothesis

prior_art_boundary: Matrix-exponential analyticity, the identity theorem, Cayley-Hamilton, variational flows, harmonic-lattice instantaneous tails, Lieb-Robinson quasi-locality, and exact causal continuum wave equations are established mathematics. No world-first or new general theorem is claimed. The repository-specific result is the convention-level theorem fork and its exact application to the registered LT3/ST8/Q3LOCK and CP1a candidates.
no_overclaim: This package proves a finite-dimensional projected variational no-go and rejects an open-neighbourhood nonlinear strict cone whenever that variational channel is nonzero. It does not prove that every finite-amplitude nonlinear perturbation has an analytic response, reject quasi-locality or a controlled continuum cone, reject discrete-time or enlarged causal parents, derive a physical state, compare to physical empty space, remove a regulator, reconstruct a horizon, complete CP1, or complete Pre-A.
